title: Synthetic reaction data from transformation rules for graph-to-sequence pretraining in biodegradation pathway prediction
abstract: arXiv:2610.19640v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The scarcity of observed biodegradation reactions constrains the training of product and pathway predictors. We present enviGraph, a framework that generates and curates synthetic reaction data, uses these data to pretrain a graph-to-sequence predictor, and fine-tunes the predictor on observed environmental reactions for product and recursive pathway prediction. Applying inherited environmental transformation rules to structures from PubChem, NORMAN SusDat and EPA DSSTox, followed by curation, produces 776,851 canonical parent-product pairs for pretraining. We compare this dataset with three United States Patent and Trademark Office (USPTO) reaction datasets: USPTO-50K, USPTO-MIT and USPTO-Stereo. We evaluate enviGraph and the sequence-based enviFormer using ten folds split by pathway on the EAWAG Biocatalysis/Biodegradation Database (BBD), regulatory pesticide biodegradation data (Soil) and activated-sludge biodegradation data (Sludge).

translated_title: 基于转化规则生成的合成反应数据用于生物降解路径预测中图到序列模型的预训练
translated_abstract: 观测到的生物降解反应数据的稀缺性限制了产物预测器和路径预测器的训练。我们提出了enviGraph框架，该框架生成并整理合成反应数据，利用这些数据预训练图到序列预测器，再在观测到的环境反应数据上进行微调，以实现产物预测和递归路径预测。将继承的环境转化规则应用于来自PubChem、NORMAN SusDat和EPA DSSTox的化学结构并加以整理，产生了776,851个标准化的母体-产物数据对用于预训练。我们将该数据集与三个美国专利商标局（USPTO）反应数据集进行比较：USPTO-50K、USPTO-MIT和USPTO-Stereo。我们采用按路径划分的十折交叉验证，在EAWAG生物催化/生物降解数据库（BBD）、监管农药生物降解数据（Soil）以及活性污泥生物降解数据上对enviGraph和基于序列的enviFormer进行了评估。
tldr: 该论文提出enviGraph框架，通过应用环境转化规则生成77万余个合成反应数据对来预训练图到序列预测器，解决了观测生物降解反应数据稀缺的问题，从而提升生物降解产物和路径预测的性能。
en_tdlr: enviGraph generates over 776,000 synthetic parent-product reaction pairs by applying environmental transformation rules to pretrain a graph-to-sequence predictor, addressing the scarcity of observed biodegradation reactions for improved product and pathway prediction.
